title: Implement headless abort
description: The structured abort a headless /implement run writes to the abort file when it cannot proceed. The orchestrator validates the file and dispatches on the type — it never trusts the run's exit code alone. See docs/adr/0005-implement-abort-contract.md.

type.description: missing-dependency: a required tool is not installed on the host and the run aborted instead of installing or working around it.

dependencies.description: The missing tools as command names (e.g. java, Xvfb).

reason.description: One line on why the tool is required and what failed.
